captures.title: Make it yours
captures.body: Theme, font size, language, and where the navigation sits — the whole interface follows the theme you pick.

captures.name: sessions
captures.title: Defaults for every run
captures.body: How the list sorts and groups, and what a new session starts with, so you set it once instead of every time.

captures.name: execution
captures.title: How much rope an agent gets
captures.body: Permission handling, auto-approval and the phrases that mean an agent has stopped early rather than finished.

captures.name: privacy
captures.title: Secrets never reach the transcript
captures.body: Tokens and keys are detected and replaced before anything is stored, and you can add patterns of your own.
